events.title: We Won Another Award!
events.summary: Greetings, Inquisitors! Just a small piece of news to share and celebrate while we’re hard at work on the game. We won another award! (The previous one was Socky for best booth on PAX, for those of you wondering) In TooManyGames 2026 Indie Game Showcase Award we won the “Best Puzzle Game” category. And you bet we’re pretty happy about it. events.title: Inkblood Playtest Ended
events.summary: Greetings, Inquisitors! The carriage is sealed shut for now! Inkblood Playtest has ended. If you missed it – fret not, we plan to have a demo in the future, available for everyone! By the way, the open playtest went great! We got more than 2000 responses in our feedback form (which you should fill in if you played the game and forgot, *wink-wink*) – and the majority of your feedback is extremely positive. events.summary: Greetings, Inquisitors! Hope you caught all the perpetrators you could. A quick heads-up! We plan to close access to Inkblood Playtest tomorrow, in 24 hours from now. So, if you didn’t have the chance to try the game – now’s the time. You should have enough time to try everything and even send your feedback!
